name: Reserve Bank of India
description: India's central bank, established under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 and commenced operations on 1 April 1935. It is responsible for monetary policy, currency issuance, banking regulation and other central-bank functions.

name: Federal Reserve System
description: The central banking system of the United States, created by the Federal Reserve Act of 1913. The Board of Governors is based in Washington, D.C.

name: Bank of England
description: The United Kingdom's central bank, founded in 1694. Its responsibilities and institutional role have evolved substantially over time.

name: International Monetary Fund
description: An international organisation established at the Bretton Woods Conference in 1944. It works on international monetary cooperation, financial stability, trade, employment and sustainable economic growth.

name: London School of Economics and Political Science
description: Founded in 1895, LSE is a university specialising in social sciences, including economics, finance, public policy and political science.

name: New York Stock Exchange
description: The NYSE traces its origins to the Buttonwood Agreement signed in 1792. The exchange has since evolved through major changes in market structure and technology.
